sources.snippet: Youtu-Embedding is a state-of-the-art, general-purpose text embedding model developed by Tencent Youtu Lab. It delivers exceptional performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, including Information Retrieval (IR), Semantic Textual Similarity (STS), Clustering, Reranking, and Classification.
